description: Narrow capability for the Meeting Room window (label `meeting-room`). Without this file the window matched NO capability at all — `default` scopes to main/vault-*/sleepy/sleepy-perch and `checklist` to checklist-* — so every core:window call it made was denied by the ACL, and because `dragWindowNow()` swallows the rejection the only symptom was a title bar that silently refused to drag. Deliberately excludes every shell:*, global-shortcut:* and notification:* permission the default capability grants: this window renders agent-authored markdown and agent-authored HTML from N different projects, so it gets only the window chrome it actually uses. Same containment pattern as checklist-window; see knowledge/dashboard-server-security.md.
